kpis.signal: Segment haute marge GoDaddy : builder Airo IA + Managed WordPress + outils ecommerce, croissance double-digit
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Applications & Commerce : website builder, Managed WordPress, outils ecommerce et marketing email. Segment haute marge tire par GoDaddy Airo (IA).
kpis.description_en: Applications & Commerce segment revenue: website builder, Managed WordPress, e-commerce and email marketing tools. High-margin segment driven by GoDaddy Airo (AI).

kpis.signal: Coeur historique GoDaddy : noms de domaine + hebergement basique. Cash-cow stable, croissance single-digit.
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Core Platform : noms de domaine (~80M domaines geres) + hebergement de base + aftermarket. Cash-cow stable, base de cross-sell vers A&C.
kpis.description_en: Core Platform segment revenue: domain names (~80M domains under management) + basic hosting + aftermarket. Stable cash-cow, cross-sell base for A&C.

kpis.signal: Bookings croissent plus vite que revenue (deferred revenue en hausse), indicateur avance de la dynamique commerciale
kpis.description_fr: Total bookings (montant facture sur la periode, hors taxes). Indicateur avance du revenue futur car GoDaddy facture annuellement les renouvellements.
kpis.description_en: Total bookings (amount billed in period, excl. taxes). Leading indicator of future revenue since GoDaddy bills annual renewals upfront.

kpis.signal: ARPU +39% sur 5 ans, monetisation per-customer en hausse continue grace au cross-sell A&C
kpis.description_fr: Revenu annuel moyen par client (TTM revenue / clients moyens). Mesure cle de la monetisation : +39% sur 5 ans grace au upsell A&C sur la base domain.
kpis.description_en: Annual average revenue per customer (TTM revenue / average customers). Key monetization metric: +39% over 5 years driven by A&C upsell on the domain base.
